_comment: Phase 2 output: distinct G1-executable motions for the Phase 1 candidate catalog.
83 semantic intents collapse to these motions -- many intents share one motion, which
is what the catalog's own rule (Hello/Hi/Good morning share GREETING) implies.
Prompts follow NVIDIA guidance in docs/source/key_concepts/limitations.md: begin with
'A person...' and use medium detail (too short is vague, too long overloads the model).
g1skel34 has no neck, head, finger or thumb joints -- 29 joints: 12 leg, 3 waist, 14 arm.
Anything relying on head or finger articulation is substituted, not omitted silently.

gestures.gesture_description: Right hand raised, open palm, waving side to side.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person raises their right hand up and waves it side to side to greet someone.

gestures.gesture_description: Slower, softer wave of farewell with the right hand.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person lifts their right hand and waves slowly to say goodbye as someone leaves.

gestures.gesture_description: Both arms open outward from the chest in an inviting motion.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person opens both arms outward from their chest in a wide welcoming gesture.

gestures.gesture_description: Right hand placed on chest with a small forward bow.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person places their right hand on their chest and bows their upper body slightly in thanks.

gestures.gesture_description: Both open palms extended forward in polite request.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person extends both hands forward with open palms in a polite requesting gesture.

gestures.gesture_description: Upper body bows forward, arms held low.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person bows their upper body forward with both arms lowered in an apology.

gestures.gesture_description: Hands brought together repeatedly in applause. Substitute for thumbs-up, which g1skel34 cannot form.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person claps their hands together repeatedly in front of their chest in applause.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm sweeps inward toward the body, calling someone over.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person raises their right arm and sweeps it inward toward their body to call someone over.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm raised, palm facing forward, held still.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person raises their right arm forward with the palm facing out to signal someone to stop.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm extended straight forward, indicating ahead.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person extends their right arm straight forward to point at something ahead of them.

gestures.gesture_description: Right hand brought to own chest, indicating self or a nearby spot.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person brings their right hand to their own chest to indicate themselves.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm raised overhead pointing upward.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person raises their right arm straight above their head to point upward.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm angled down toward the floor.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person lowers their right arm and points down toward the ground.

gestures.gesture_description: Left arm extended sideways to the robot's left.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person extends their left arm out to the side to point to their left.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm extended sideways to the robot's right.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person extends their right arm out to the side to point to their right.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm swings back over the shoulder indicating behind.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person turns their upper body and points backward over their shoulder with their right arm.

gestures.gesture_description: Both palms pressed slowly downward.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person lowers both hands slowly with palms facing down in a calming gesture.

gestures.gesture_description: Both palms lifted upward, inviting someone to rise.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person lifts both hands upward with palms facing up to invite someone to stand.

gestures.gesture_description: Shoulders lifted with both forearms turned outward, palms up.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person shrugs their shoulders and turns both palms upward to show they do not know.

gestures.gesture_description: Hands start together then spread wide apart.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person holds both hands together then spreads them far apart to show something large.

gestures.gesture_description: Hands brought close together in front of the body. Approximate: a finger pinch is impossible on g1skel34.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person brings both hands close together in front of their body to show something small.

gestures.gesture_description: Right arm sweeps outward, open palm up, presenting.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person sweeps their right arm outward with the palm facing up to present something.

gestures.gesture_description: Both arms reach forward, palms up, asking for assistance.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person reaches both arms forward with open palms asking for help.

gestures.gesture_description: Both arms raised sharply in warning.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person raises both arms up sharply in front of them to warn of danger.

gestures.gesture_description: Both arms cross in front of the chest. Substitute for a head shake, which g1skel34 cannot perform.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person crosses both arms in front of their chest to refuse something.

gestures.gesture_description: Upper body leans forward and back in an agreeing motion. Substitute for a nod: g1skel34 has no neck joint.
gestures.kimodo_prompt: A person leans their upper body forward and back in a clear nodding motion of agreement.
